FN-84NN3FH-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 5
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Gerald H. Allen
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/24/2026
Senate Bill 5 as introduced would propose a constitutional amendment which, if ratified, could
increase the administrative costs of local boards of education by an undetermined amount to
establish policies requiring public K-12 schools to broadcast "The Star-Spangled Banner" at
least once a week during school hours.
In addition, this bill would increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the
State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30,
2027.
